items.title: Benny Powell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 16, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I had the pleasure of sitting next to Jonah Jones and talking to him, and it was utterly fascinating.

ctx.x: And the last is Lionel Hampton, Gary Burton and myself, and I don’t know who the bass player was. But every so often when I’m going through files and stuff, I’ll run across pictures like this, and to me, right now, I’m sort of objective about it. It’s like it happened to somebody else. And I still feel like a little kid when I’m around — just recently I was at Lincoln Center two nights ago, and to pay tribute to Duke Ellington, and well even around Max and Randy, I still feel like the little kid who’s wow, these…
Well I can relate to that because that’s how I feel being around guys like you.
